retention_inspection.method: Bounded reads of existing spans; no fresh invocations
retention_inspection.conversion_note: X-Ray-to-OTel conversion retains API identity in _aws.xray.name, leaves the top-level name empty, and classifies HTTP 4xx as ERROR. These are stored representations, not the original SDK span contract.

limitations: The first 0.5-second export timed out and canceled the X-Ray request.
A batch-processor configuration caused extension initialization failure and was removed through a reviewed recovery plan.
The initial retention check used the incorrect /aws/spans name; the confirmed destination is aws/spans without a leading slash.
The bounded X-Ray summary query returned no summaries; only 1 percent of spans are indexed as summaries. This is not an export failure.
This collector-retention check did not invoke the worker model; a separate lightweight workflow check is recorded in api-worker-trace-linkage.json.
